verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents official client libraries for Python, Node, PHP, Java, Ruby, Elixir, C#, Go and Clojure. The SDKs handle ECDSA request signing automatically and select the base URL by environment. A first-party GitHub sdk-python repo exposes rich resource coverage (VerifiedAccounts, PaymentPreviews, CorporateCards, DictKeys, etc.). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, plus evidence of resource depth for the non-Python SDKs.
